name: hllmr-web
description: HLLMR static websites: shared design, brand and portfolio packages and per-site Astro builds (silo.hllmr.com, hllmr.com, dhellmer.com and the HLLMR division sites).

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check && npm run test:contract
scripts.check: node scripts/check-built-html.mjs sites/silo/dist && html-validate "sites/silo/dist/**/*.html" && node scripts/check-internal-links.mjs sites/silo/dist && node scripts/gen-nginx-redirects.mjs --check
scripts.check:hllmr: node scripts/check-built-html.mjs sites/hllmr/dist && html-validate "sites/hllmr/dist/**/*.html" && node scripts/check-internal-links.mjs sites/hllmr/dist
scripts.test:hllmr: npm run build:hllmr && npm run check:hllmr && node --test tests/url-contract/hllmr.contract.mjs
scripts.check:dhellmer: node scripts/check-built-html.mjs sites/dhellmer/dist && html-validate "sites/dhellmer/dist/**/*.html" && node scripts/check-internal-links.mjs sites/dhellmer/dist
scripts.test:dhellmer: npm run build:dhellmer && npm run check:dhellmer && node --test tests/url-contract/dhellmer.contract.mjs
scripts.check:tools: node scripts/check-built-html.mjs sites/tools/dist && html-validate "sites/tools/dist/**/*.html" && node scripts/check-internal-links.mjs sites/tools/dist
scripts.test:tools: npm run build:tools && npm run check:tools && node --test tests/url-contract/tools.contract.mjs
scripts.check:upgrade: node scripts/check-built-html.mjs sites/upgrade/dist && html-validate "sites/upgrade/dist/**/*.html" && node scripts/check-internal-links.mjs sites/upgrade/dist
scripts.test:upgrade: npm run build:upgrade && npm run check:upgrade && node --test tests/url-contract/upgrade.contract.mjs
scripts.check:live: node scripts/check-built-html.mjs sites/live/dist && html-validate "sites/live/dist/**/*.html" && node scripts/check-internal-links.mjs sites/live/dist
scripts.test:live: npm run build:live && npm run check:live && node --test tests/url-contract/live.contract.mjs
scripts.check:gaming: node scripts/check-built-html.mjs sites/gaming/dist && html-validate "sites/gaming/dist/**/*.html" && node scripts/check-internal-links.mjs sites/gaming/dist
scripts.test:gaming: npm run build:gaming && npm run check:gaming && node --test tests/url-contract/gaming.contract.mjs
